description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'TbAbstractGetMappedDataNode' that handles data mapping and retrieval operations within the Thingsboard rule engine, including processing entity fields, attributes, and telemetry data, and transforming messages accordingly.

classes.name: TbAbstractGetMappedDataNode
classes.description: An abstract class for nodes that retrieve and map data from entities, handling entity fields, attributes, and telemetry, and transforming messages accordingly.

methods.name: checkIfMappingIsNotEmptyOrElseThrow
methods.description: Checks if the data mapping is not null or empty; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: processFieldsData
methods.description: Processes entity fields data asynchronously and updates the message.

methods.name: processAttributesKvEntryData
methods.description: Processes attribute key-value entries asynchronously and updates the message.

methods.name: processTsKvEntryData
methods.description: Processes latest telemetry key-value entries asynchronously and updates the message.

methods.name: putFieldsDataAndTell
methods.description: Inserts processed fields data into message and sends success.

methods.name: putKvEntryDataAndTell
methods.description: Inserts key-value entries into message and sends success.

methods.name: processFieldsMappingPatterns
methods.description: Generates a mapping of source fields to target keys with pattern processing.

methods.name: processKvEntryMappingPatterns
methods.description: Generates a mapping of source keys to target keys with pattern processing.

methods.name: getEntityFieldsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously loads entity fields and maps them according to the provided mappings.

methods.name: getAttributesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves attribute entries for an entity.

methods.name: getLatestTelemetryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves latest telemetry data for an entity.
